hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A subset product has no square factors if each prime factor appears at most once overall.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Map each number to a bitmask representing its prime factorization over small prime numbers.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Transition using a bitmask knapsack table tracking counts of square-free combinations modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Subset product DP over bitmasks for primes up to 30.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 2^n subsets is intractable for n up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP array of size 1024 stores valid mask combinations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models prime factors as bitmasks in subset-sum style DP.
